verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI insights or suggestions built into Okta itself. The official open-source MCP server does let an external LLM or agent query Okta data in natural language, with examples like failed logins in the last 24 hours and apps unused for a month, so insights are possible only through an extra external AI tool. Missing for 10: native in-product AI-generated insights or recommendations, first-party documentation of an embedded AI analytics feature, and independent hands-on corroboration.
